title: Superstar Operations VA
description:
Operations VA - No Degree or Experience Needed. English MUST be good. Sharp Problem-Solvers Only.



## JOB TYPE

Full-time (40 hrs/week)



## SALARY

$350 to $600 per month, paid on time, every time. Starting rate depends on how you perform in our hiring process. Not on your resume.



---



## JOB DESCRIPTION



**Read this whole post carefully. How you apply is the first test.**



We're a fast-growing international social media marketing agency (US-registered). We manage content operations and social accounts for online creators.



We're hiring an Operations VA to become a core part of our team. The work includes managing trackers and reports in Google Sheets, online research, keeping our SOPs updated, coordinating follow-ups across the team, inbox and schedule support, and whatever fires need putting out that week. The tasks are trainable. What we can't train is how you think, that's what we're hiring for.



**Why this role is different from your last VA job:**



- **We don't care about your degree.** College grad, undergrad, no degree — irrelevant. We will never ask.

- **We don't care about your years of experience.** We'd rather hire a sharp first-timer than a 5-year VA with bad habits.

- **We pay above market** because we expect above-market thinking. One great VA is worth more to us than three average ones and is paid like it.

- **You'll be trusted with real responsibility.** We don't micromanage. We give you the goal, you figure out the path, you flag problems early.



**You're the right person if:**



- When instructions are unclear, you make a smart assumption, state it, and keep moving — you don't freeze or go silent

- When a tool is unfamiliar, you Google it and figure it out before asking

- When something breaks, you flag it immediately instead of hiding it

- You deliver before deadlines without being reminded

- Your written English is clear enough that a US client could read it without confusion



**Do NOT apply if:**



- You need step-by-step instructions for every task

- You're currently juggling 2–3 other clients (this is full-time and exclusive)

- You go offline when things get hard

- You're the type to say "I don't know how" as a final answer



**Pay & perks:**



- $350 to $550 per month. Depending on performance in our process

- Paid training, paid hiring test tasks, performance raises reviewed every 6 months

- Long-term role — we're building a team, not renting freelancers



---



## HOW TO APPLY (this is the first test — most applicants will fail it)



Applications that don't follow these instructions exactly are deleted without being read. This is how we filter for people who read carefully.



**Start your application with the word CALAMANSI**, then answer these three questions. No resume needed. No cover letter template. We can smell those.



1. Tell us about a problem you solved completely on your own, with no one available to ask for help. Be specific, what was it, what did you try, what worked? (3–5 sentences)

2. Describe a time you were given unclear instructions. What did you do? (2–4 sentences)

3. You're assigned a task using a tool you've never seen before. Walk us through your first 30 minutes. (2–4 sentences)



Then include:

- A screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net)

- One sentence about your backup plan for power/internet outages



**What happens next:** If your application passes, you'll receive a short timed assessment, then a scenario test, then a PAID test task (yes, we pay you for test work), then a short video interview. The whole process takes about 2 weeks. Successful candidates start on a 30-day paid trial at full rate.



We reply to every applicant who follows the instructions even rejections. If you didn't follow the instructions, you won't hear from us.

title: Driving School Scheduler
description:
Location: Remote (Must work on Eastern Standard Time - EST)

Job Type: Part-Time (Exactly 35 Hours per Week)

Salary: $3.00 / hour

Reporting to: Virtual Assistant Supervisor



Job Summary:

Aarcon Driving School is seeking a high-energy, detail-oriented Virtual Agent to manage student pipelines, instructor logistics, and scheduling for our Dayton, Ohio market. This position requires 35 hours per week, and mandatory rotating weekend shifts are required. We pride ourselves on our distinct brand promises: NO waitlists, same-day driving possibilities, a flexible $199 down payment plan, and full home pick-up/drop-off services.



Core Responsibilities:

Calendar Management: Coordinate daily behind-the-wheel driving schedules for instructors using Driver Ed Solution software.



Route Optimization: Geographically cluster lessons across Dayton to eliminate instructor downtime.



Retention: Execute automated text/email reminders to eliminate student no-shows.



Requirements:



Exceptional, completely fluent written and verbal English skills.



Hands-on experience or deep familiarity with GoHighLevel and Driver Ed Solution.



Ability to work 35 hours/week on EST, including mandatory rotating weekends.



Reliable computer, noise-canceling headset, high-speed internet, and power/internet backup plans.



How to Apply:

Submit your resume and include a 1-minute audio recording (via Loom or Vocaroo) introducing yourself and summarizing your calendar logistics or GoHighLevel experience.



APPLICANT SCREENING QUESTIONS

Native / Fully Fluent (Exceptional)



Advanced



Intermediate (Disqualify)



Beginner (Disqualify)

GoHighLevel (GHL)



Driver Ed Solution



Neither (Disqualify)

Yes, fully available.



No (Disqualify)

Yes



No (Disqualify)



THE 2-WEEK TRAINING ITINERARY

Week 1: Foundations, Systems, & Compliance (35 Hours)



Days 1–2 (12 Hours): Set up accounts in GHL and Driver Ed Solution. Memorize Aarcon's core hooks ($199 down, no waitlist, home pick-up). Study Ohio BMV compliance rules.



Days 3–5 (18 Hours): Practice GHL pipeline movements. Learn Dayton geography (Beavercreek, Kettering, Huber Heights, Trotwood) to map efficient instructor routes.



Day 6 - Weekend Shift (5 Hours): Live Zoom shadowing with the Virtual Assistant Supervisor during high-volume weekend booking slots.



Week 2: Calendar Ownership & Conflict Resolution (35 Hours)



Days 7–9 (12 Hours): Input active schedules into Driver Ed Solution. Group lessons geographically to cut travel gaps. Supervisor reviews all draft calendars.



Days 10–11 (18 Hours): Manage late-notice cancellations. Deploy 24/48-hour GHL reminder scripts to protect instructor hours.



Day 12 - Weekend Shift (5 Hours): Solo inbox and calendar management. End the shift with a 30-minute KPI performance review with the Supervisor.



GHL COMMUNICATON SCRIPTS

Initial Inquiry Script:

"Hi {{ contact.first_name }}, thank you for reaching out to Aarcon Driving School! ???? We have NO waitlist in the Dayton area, meaning your student can start classroom instruction today and get behind the wheel within 24 to 72 hours! We also offer free home pick-up and drop-off, and you can get started today with just a $199 down payment plan. Are you looking to enroll a Teen (under 21) or an Adult?"



24-Hour Retention Reminder:

"Hi {{ contact.first_name }}, this is your reminder from Aarcon Driving School. ???? {{ contact.first_name }} has a behind-the-wheel driving lesson scheduled for {{ appointment.start_time }}. Your instructor will pick you up directly from the address on file. Please reply CONFIRM to lock this in. Note: Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance will incur a missed-lesson fee."



SUPERVISOR PERFORMANCE & DISCIPLINARY POLICY

Daily Scorecard Targets:



First Response Time (FRT): Under 15 minutes for new GHL leads.



Pipeline Conversion Rate: Minimum 15% of inquiries converted to a $199 deposit.



Calendar Capacity: Keep instructor driving logs at 90%+ efficiency.



Disciplinary Workflow:



Step 1: Verbal Warning via a private 10-minute video sync.



Step 2: Written Warning along with a mandatory 14-day Performance Improvement Plan (PIP).



Step 3: Final Written Warning stating next infraction results in contract termination.



Step 4: Immediate contract termination and instant revocation of all GHL/Driver Ed Solution logins.



Immediate bypass to Step 4 will occur for Gross Negligence (sharing system passwords, exporting customer data, or using profane language).

Contractor Name: [Insert Name] | Rate: $3.00/hr | Total Hours: 35.0 | Total Due: $105.00 USD



Mon–Fri Shifts: 6.0 Hours per day (9:00 AM – 3:30 PM EST, 30-min break)

This role requires a strong understanding of Philippine tax and payroll regulations to ensure compliance with local laws and supporting U.S. business operations. • Supervise staff accountant.

• In-depth knowledge of Philippine tax laws, payroll requirements, and statutory compliance.

• Demonstrate a willingness to learn and have the ability to work well with others.

title: AI Engineer / Python develoer
description:
# AI Engineer (Project-Based Contract)



**Location:** Remote

**Job Type:** Contract / Freelance

**Project Duration:** 2–3 Months (Possible Extension)



## About the Project



We are looking for a talented AI Engineer to help us build an AI-powered application using modern Large Language Model (LLM) technologies. You will work closely with our development team to design, develop, and deploy intelligent features such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, document processing, and workflow automation.



This is an excellent opportunity for engineers who enjoy solving real-world problems with Generative AI and building production-ready applications.



## Responsibilities



* Design and develop AI-powered applications using Python.

* Build scalable REST APIs using FastAPI.

* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.

* Integrate Large Language Models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar).

* Develop document ingestion pipelines for PDF, DOCX, CSV, and other file formats.

* Generate and manage embeddings for semantic search.

* Configure and optimize vector databases such as Qdrant, Pinecone, or Chroma.

* Build AI agents and multi-agent workflows using LangChain or LangGraph.

* Optimize prompts to improve AI response quality and reduce hallucinations.

* Integrate AI services with existing web applications and third-party APIs.

* Work with PostgreSQL and Redis for application data and caching.

* Containerize applications using Docker.

* Collaborate with frontend developers and product stakeholders.

* Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.



## Required Qualifications



* Strong experience with Python development.

* Experience building REST APIs with FastAPI.

* Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI.

* Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar AI frameworks.

* Familiarity with vector databases such as Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Chroma.

* Experience with embedding models and semantic search.

* Knowledge of SQL databases, preferably PostgreSQL.

* Experience using Git and GitHub for version control.

* Understanding of Docker and containerized deployments.

* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

* Good written and verbal English communication skills.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience deploying AI applications to cloud platforms.

* Knowledge of Redis, Celery, or background job processing.

* Experience with React or other frontend frameworks.

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.

* Experience working with enterprise AI applications.

* Knowledge of prompt engineering and evaluation techniques.

* Experience integrating external APIs and automation workflows.



## Nice-to-Have Skills



* n8n or workflow automation platforms

* Azure OpenAI or AWS Bedrock

* Hugging Face Transformers

* OCR and document intelligence

* AI chatbots and conversational AI

* Authentication and role-based access control

* Monitoring and logging tools



## What You'll Build



During this project, you'll help develop features such as:



* AI-powered document search

* Enterprise RAG system

* Intelligent chatbot with citations

* Multi-agent AI workflows

* Knowledge base management

* Semantic search

* AI workflow automation

* Admin dashboard

* Secure authentication

* Production-ready REST APIs



## What We Offer



* Fully remote work

* Flexible working hours

* Competitive project-based compensation

* Opportunity for contract extension or long-term collaboration

* Exposure to modern AI technologies and production systems

* Collaborative and supportive engineering environment



If you're passionate about Generative AI and enjoy building practical, production-ready AI applications, we'd love to hear from you. Please include your resume, portfolio, GitHub profile, and any relevant AI projects with your application.

title: Virtual Assistant — YouTube Channel Launch & Content Operations
description:
Experienced YouTube Video Editor — 90-Day Daily Upload Challenge

Rate: Hourly rate DOE** (see note on rate below) 

Commitment: Full-time role. This is not a side-gig or a few-hours-a-week arrangement. I'm producing one fully finished YouTube video every single day for 90 days, and I need someone whose primary job is making that happen.



About the Role:



I'm launching a YouTube channel around a 90-day challenge: one video published every day, no exceptions, for 90 days. I need an experienced YouTube video editor — not a generalist VA — who has done high-volume, fast-turnaround editing before and can prove it.

This is a real working relationship, not a one-off gig, and I want to build trust with whoever I hire. But trust starts with consistent, on-time delivery — so this posting is specific about what "done" looks like and how we'll track progress from day one.



The Daily Deliverable (Non-Negotiable):



Every single day, I need one fully completed, upload-ready YouTube video, meaning:

Fully edited (cuts, pacing, on-screen graphics, prior-video clips inserted where needed)

Captions added

Custom thumbnail created with a constant eye towards the branding

Uploaded to YouTube with the video description area, or "More" info section and metadata filled in; this will expand as other products, including a Membership are added

A brief daily progress report — what was completed, what's in progress, and any blockers — sent to me at a consistent time each day



Must-Have Skills (Day One):



Proven, demonstrable experience editing YouTube videos at volume — not just occasional projects

Fluent, polished written and spoken English

Captioning and thumbnail design

Sense of style and restraint

Fast turnaround — same-day or next-day delivery, every day, for 90 days straight; can advance load videos to get ahead of the daily schedule; to be discussed

Reliable, honest, proactive communication — you flag problems early, not the night before deadline

The job does not have to end at the end of the 90 days



How Hiring Will Work:



Portfolio review. I'll review submitted work samples first and only move qualified applicants forward. This respects both our time.

Paid editing test. Shortlisted candidates complete a small, paid test edit (2 videos taken from raw footage to finished video with captions and thumbnail) on a real deadline, so we both see actual working speed and quality before anything bigger is on the line. The first of two videos will allow a little longer in order to establish the branding and video editing requests, and the second video will be required to be upload-ready within 20 hours to allow for creator’s review and approval, and a timely upload consistency.

Two-week working checkpoint. If hired, the first two weeks are a working evaluation period. I'm looking for consistent, on-time, complete daily deliverables from day one — not a slow ramp-up. If it's clear by the two-week mark that the pace or quality isn't sustainable, we'll part ways quickly and respectfully rather than let it drag on for either of us.

Ongoing role. Once you've shown consistent delivery through the checkpoint, this may become a stable, ongoing full-time role beyond the 90-day sprint, with room to take on more of the "also needed" skills below over time.



Also Needed (Can Ramp Up Together, Not Day-One Requirements):



YouTube channel management (profile/branding screens)

Creating short/clipped videos from long-form content

Video transcription

Downloadable lead magnets (PDF design, text + graphics)

Landing page creation for product sales

 marketing: promo
s in my voice, newsletter management, list building/growth

Substack post support, publishing and management

Other social media posting and management

YouTube ads/marketing basics

(You don't need to be an expert in every item above right now — tell me honestly which of these you already do well vs. where you'd need guidance.)



To Apply:



Please send:

2–3 links to YouTube videos/thumbnails you've edited or designed (your own work, not just examples you admire) — ideally showing consistent, high-volume output, not one-off polished pieces

A one-paragraph note on your experience with high-volume, fast-turnaround editing specifically (how many videos/week or videos per day, what platforms, what your typical turnaround time was)

Confirmation you're able to complete a paid test edit on a short deadline as part of the process



* A note on rate: this role asks for a real skill combination (editing, design, fast daily turnaround, full-time commitment) at an experienced level. I want to pay a rate that attracts someone who can actually deliver at that level, so this will be discussed to ensure the working arrangement is mutually beneficial.

title: Growth & Partnerships Coordinator (Healthcare)
description:
Growth & Partnerships Coordinator (Healthcare)

Remote – Philippines



________________________________________



About Sandalwood Mental Health



Sandalwood Mental Health is a growing outpatient psychiatric practice dedicated to providing compassionate, evidence-based mental health care through telehealth. Our providers specialize in general adult psychiatry, integrative psychiatry, and one of the nation's few specialty outpatient programs focused on individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) and co-occurring mental health conditions.



As we continue expanding into new states and developing partnerships with healthcare providers, community organizations, and insurance networks, we are seeking an organized, motivated, and dependable professional to join our remote administrative team.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys project management, research, relationship building, and helping meaningful healthcare services reach more people.

________________________________________

Position Summary



The Growth & Partnerships Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the continued growth of Sandalwood Mental Health. This position focuses on developing referral relationships, coordinating marketing initiatives, conducting research, assisting with strategic business development projects, and ensuring important growth initiatives continue moving forward.



This is not a commission-based sales position. Instead, you will help connect healthcare providers, organizations, and patients with specialized psychiatric services while supporting a variety of administrative and operational projects.



This is a growth-oriented position. We are looking for someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, improving systems, building relationships, and helping our organization grow. Success is measured not simply by completing assigned tasks, but by consistently contributing ideas and executing initiatives that help expand our referral network, strengthen partnerships, improve marketing efforts, and support sustainable practice growth.



As a member of a small, collaborative team, this position will also occasionally provide operational support by backfilling other administrative staff during vacations, illnesses, periods of high call volume, or other staffing needs. This may include answering phones, scheduling appointments, responding to patient inquiries using approved workflows, or completing other administrative responsibilities. While these duties are not the primary focus of the position, flexibility and teamwork are essential.



You will work closely with practice leadership and have the opportunity to grow alongside an expanding healthcare organization.

________________________________________

Primary Responsibilities



Referral & Partnership Development

• Research physicians, therapists, psychologists, hospitals, case managers, community organizations, IDD service providers, and other referral sources.

• Research potential new markets and affiliated stakeholders.

• Develop and maintain referral databases and CRM records.

• Draft professional outreach
s, letters, and presentations.

• Coordinate and execute referral outreach campaigns.

• Schedule meetings, presentations, and follow-up communications.

• Track partnership opportunities and referral activities.

• Assist with networking initiatives and ongoing relationship development.

• Identify opportunities for new strategic partnerships.

• Maintain organized documentation of outreach efforts and outcomes.

________________________________________

Marketing Coordination

• Coordinate projects with Sandalwood's external marketing agency.

• Assist with website updates and provider biographies.

• Maintain Psychology Today and other provider directory profiles.

• Maintain social media posting schedules and content.

• Coordinate updates to Google Business Profiles when needed.

• Assist with newsletters and educational campaigns.

• Monitor online provider listings for accuracy and consistency.

• Assist with implementation of new marketing initiatives.

________________________________________

Content Development

Utilize AI tools and other software to help create and manage:

• Educational articles

• Blog content

• Provider spotlights

• Social media content

• Newsletters

• Patient education materials

• Presentation materials

• Marketing collateral

• Referral packets

• Educational resources for providers and community organizations

________________________________________

Research & Special Projects

• Research healthcare organizations and referral opportunities.

• Research insurance networks and community resources.

• Research competitors, emerging markets, and industry trends.

• Organize project documentation.

• Assist with conference planning and educational events.

• Prepare reports, dashboards, and spreadsheets.

• Assist with monthly operations report compilation

• Support leadership with strategic initiatives.

• Recommend workflow improvements and growth opportunities.

• Perform additional special projects as assigned.

________________________________________

Administrative & Team Support



As part of a collaborative team, this position may periodically provide operational coverage by:

• Answering incoming telephone calls.

• Scheduling and rescheduling patient appointments.

• Responding to patient inquiries using approved scripts and processes.

• Monitoring shared
 inboxes.

• Assisting with administrative projects.

• Supporting office staff during periods of increased workload or planned absences.



Everyone at Sandalwood contributes to the success of the team, and we value flexibility, adaptability, and a willingness to help wherever needed.

________________________________________

Qualifications



Required

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Strong organizational skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail.

• Advanced spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel).

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Strong internet research skills.

• Excellent time management.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection.

• Quiet, professional home office environment.

• Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with the team.

• Previous project management experience or previous marketing/business development experience.

• Strong interest in healthcare and helping improve access to mental health services.



Preferred

• Previous healthcare experience.

• Virtual Assistant experience.

• Executive Assistant experience.

• CRM experience.

• Canva experience.

• Google Workspace proficiency.

• Microsoft Office proficiency.

• Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT.

• Basic video editing experience.

• Healthcare marketing experience.

• Experience working remotely for a U.S.-based organization.

________________________________________

Personal Qualities



We're looking for someone who is:

• Highly dependable.

• Honest and trustworthy.

• Curious and eager to learn.

• Professional in written and verbal communication.

• Friendly and approachable.

• Organized and detail-oriented.

• Comfortable learning new technology.

• Resourceful and proactive.

• Able to identify problems and suggest practical solutions.

• Comfortable balancing strategic projects with day-to-day operational support.

• Interested in building a long-term career with our practice.

________________________________________



90-Day Introductory Period



Employment begins with a 90-day introductory period designed to ensure a successful transition for both you and Sandalwood Mental Health.



Formal reviews will occur at approximately 30, 60, and 90 days. During this period, you'll receive coaching, feedback, and progressively greater responsibility.



First 30 Days (subject to adjustment)

• Learn Sandalwood's services, providers, systems, workflows, and target referral markets.

• Complete onboarding and training.

description:
We are an early-stage AI startup building an intelligence tool for people who run paid online communities. UK-based, moving fast, looking for someone sharp and reliable to support our go-to-market over the next couple of months, with strong potential to continue if the fit is good.



What you will do:

Research and identify paid community operators who use WhatsApp, build and maintain our prospect tracker, post outreach content into relevant online communities, schedule LinkedIn content, and keep our records clean and up to date. This is a research and judgement role, not admin. We care far more about accuracy and clear thinking than speed.



You are a good fit if you:



 • Have strong written English and can assess whether a business fits specific criteria from public information

 • Are meticulous — 20 accurate, well-evidenced results beats 100 sloppy ones every time

 • Can commit to consistent hours each week for at least 8 weeks

 • Work independently and communicate proactively when something is unclear



Hours and pay:

Around 15 hours per week. Strong likelihood of ongoing work beyond the initial 8 weeks for the right person.



How to apply:



We receive a high volume of applications. To make sure we only hear from people who are genuinely suited to this role, we ask you to answer four questions as part of your application. Please paste your answers directly into your application message.



Do not use AI to write your answers. We will be able to tell, and it will disqualify your application immediately.



Question 1: Find one real example of a paid online community that uses WhatsApp as part of how it runs. Paste the link and write one sentence explaining how you know it is paid.



Question 2: We need to research around 50 community operators per week. Describe your process for finding them in 3 to 5 sentences.



Question 3: What is your current weekly availability in hours, and what are your other commitments right now — work, study, or otherwise?



Question 4: Describe a specific time you had to find information about a business or person from public sources. What were you looking for, what did you find, and how did you find it?



Applications that do not include answers to all four questions will not be read.

title: B2B Growth Marketing Manager | LinkedIn Ads | Google Ads | Demand Generation
description:
About the Role





This is a senior, strategy-led growth role. You own the paid acquisition and lead-gen roadmap end to end, set the numeric targets, and are measured on qualified pipeline delivered, not activity completed. You are not personally building every campaign. Execution (ad-building, copywriting, landing pages) is delegated to freelancers or agency partners that you brief, manage, and hold accountable.



The role sits across a multi-brand B2B portfolio, so a big part of the job is prioritisation: d
 where spend and attention go each quarter and being disciplined enough to pull resources from what isn't working. If you've only run one brand's ad account before, this will feel different; if you've worked agency-side or across a multi-brand group, this is likely familiar territory.



The portfolio spans creative/digital agency services, corporate travel management, staffing and recruitment, specialist tech recruitment, and security/compliance technology. Each business has a different buyer (procurement, HR, security/compliance leads, corporate travel managers), but all share a B2B sales motion: longer cycles, account-based targeting, lead quality over volume. This is a remote role and requires strong async communication given the time difference with the Australian leadership team.









Key Responsibilities



Strategy and Prioritisation



Own the B2B paid acquisition roadmap across the portfolio, prioritising spend by commercial stage and opportunity

Group companies into channel clusters by buyer and sales motion, defining platform and funnel per cluster

Set and own quarterly numeric targets per cluster with each business lead

Execution Oversight



Brief and manage freelancers or agencies per cluster; audit and correct their work

Oversee LinkedIn Ads as the primary channel, supplemented by Google Ads for intent capture

Own CRM/pipeline data hygiene; reporting is only as good as the data feeding it

Coordinate with existing SEO/organic workstreams

Reporting and Accountability



Deliver one consolidated pipeline/spend report weekly, plus a monthly per-cluster deep dive, in a fixed dashboard format, written clearly enough to be read asynchronously without a live call

Report against agreed numeric targets, not vanity metrics

Flag underperforming clusters within two weeks of a target miss and propose reallocation; do not wait to be asked

Quarterly review against targets; two consecutive missed quarters on a cluster triggers a strategy reset for that cluster, not just continued spend





Requirements



5+ years running B2B paid acquisition, ideally multi-brand, agency-side, or in a portfolio/holding company

Strong LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads experience for B2B lead gen; ABM experience a plus

Comfortable across different B2B motions (channel-led compliance sales, staffing, agency services, corporate accounts)

Track record of being measured against, and hitting, numeric pipeline targets, not just running campaigns

Fluent written and spoken English; comfortable working with Australian stakeholders and communication norms

Reliable internet connection and a dedicated home office setup suitable for client-facing calls

Self-directed; comfortable managing freelancers/agencies rather than a large in-house team





Nice to Have



Prior experience working directly with an Australian or other Western client/employer

Experience in recruitment/staffing, security/compliance tech, corporate travel, or creative agency sectors

Experience supporting a multi-business operator who needs concise, prioritised communication

Familiarity with HubSpot, ClickUp, or similar CRM/pipeline tools

About us

We're Flex, an online fitness coaching brand for women. We help everyday women get stronger, leaner and more confident through structured training and nutrition. Our leads come to us through Instagram, and we sell our coaching directly inside Instagram DMs 



no cold outreach, no sales calls, just warm conversations with people who have already raised their hand. We're looking for a reliable, personable DM closer to own our Instagram inbox and turn those conversations into signups.



The role

You'll be the voice of the brand inside our Instagram DMs. People message us because they want help with their training and nutrition, and your job is to guide those conversations warmly and confidently until they're ready to join our coaching program. You won't need to make anything up or give fitness advice off the top of your head, we give you a complete playbook: a step-by-step sales process, ready-to-use message scripts for almost every situation, and an answer library for common questions. 



Your job is to read each conversation carefully, follow the process, personalise the scripts lightly so they sound human, and close. This is a chat-based sales role. There are no phone calls and no video, everything happens over text.



What you'll do day to day



Manage and reply to incoming Instagram DMs promptly throughout the day

Follow our sales process: understand what the person wants, uncover their real struggle, position our program, handle questions and objections, and close



Use our provided scripts and answer library, adapting them so replies feel warm and natural (never robotic copy-paste)

Keep replies short, friendly and on-brand. you'll be writing as the coach, in first person

Ask one clear question at a time and never repeat something the lead has already told you



Send the signup link at the right 
nt (after the person is ready), then hand them into onboarding

Follow up with warm leads who went quiet

Flag and escalate anything outside a normal fitness conversation (e.g. health-sensitive situations) to us rather than answering it yourself

Keep simple records of conversations, signups and follow-ups



What we're looking for



Excellent written English, warm, casual, natural and fully fluent. This is the single most important skill. If you use AI to assist, i don't care. But if i can tell you're using AI to assist, i will care, because then the leads will be able to tell as well.



Strong attention to detail. you actually read the whole conversation before replying.

A knack for people and persuasion. you can build trust and guide someone to a decision without being pushy.

Reliability and consistency. online during agreed hours, responsive to messages.

Coachable and process-driven. happy to follow a proven playbook rather than freelancing your own approach.

Discreet and trustworthy. you'll have access to our inbox and represent our brand directly.

Comfortable working independently from home with a stable internet connection.



Nice to have (not required)

Previous experience in DM sales, setting/closing, social media management, or online coaching/health brands; familiarity with Instagram DMs; an interest in fitness and health. You do not need a fitness background. everything you need is in our playbook.



Hours & pay

Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week. $5 AUD per hr plus sales commission tier, paid weekly. Some flexibility on schedule, but we need consistent inbox coverage through the day.



10 sales for the week - $50

title: Podcast / Social Media Growth Strategist
description:
ABOUT FEMALE STARTUP CLUB



Howdy! We’re Female Startup Club, a top-ranking business podcast and media brand for ambitious women building wealth, wisdom and soul. For 750+ episodes we’ve sat down with the most successful (and most interesting) women on the planet;



? from Gold Medal Olympians like Bronte Campbell

? to Billionaires like Allison Ellsworth (Poppi)

? to the founders, inventors and CEOs you haven’t heard of yet



We’re a Techstars S24 company with a global community of 160,000+ women, a newsletter 45,000 strong, and a brand women genuinely trust. We publish a weekly interview, a weekly solo show and a weekly AI series, and our content lives everywhere our audience does.



HOW TO APPLY (READ THIS FIRST)



Send us a short Loom (3 to 5 minutes) walking us through exactly what you’d do to promote one podcast episode. Pick any episode of ours, and show us how you’d turn it into short-form content that travels: what you’d clip, why, how you’d cut it, where you’d post it and how you’d get it seen. This is the main thing we’re looking at, so put your energy here.



Also start your written application with the word [CODEWORD] so we know you read this.



YOUR MISSION



Take every episode we record and decide how it becomes short-form content that actually travels.



You’re the person who decides what becomes a clip, why it’ll stop a scroll, and how it should be cut. Then you brief our short-form editor to make it happen, watch what worked, and do more of it. You are the brain, not the hands. The editor cuts, you decide. It’s the single biggest lever we have on growth right now. If “going viral is just luck” is your worldview, this isn’t the role for you. We want someone who can tell us why a clip flew, then do it again on purpose.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



Pick the moments. Listen to every episode and choose the 4 to 6 moments most likely to travel, with a real rubric, not a hunch. Mark the exact timecodes and words. This is the heart of the job.



Direct the edit. Write the clip brief for our editor: the hook, the on-screen text, the treatment and the vibe. You don’t need to be in CapCut yourself, but you spec it so clearly the editor can cut it without coming back to you, and you sign off on every clip.



Own the growth plays. Post natively to Instagram and TikTok and seed the first comments. Tag every guest across Instagram, LinkedIn and X within 24 hours, native to each platform. Run our LinkedIn growth play, around 200 connections a month plus targeted DMs.



Read the numbers. Every week, tell us in plain English which clips drove profile visits and follows, what worked, what flopped, and feed it straight back into next week’s picks.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS



A clip strategy and selection system running every week without Doone or PA in the loop. Clips regularly clearing 10,000 views, with recurring 100,000+ crackers. Every guest gets their clip kit within 48 hours and actually reshares it. And a one-page weekly read on performance that genuinely changes what we make next.



WHO YOU ARE



You can watch a 60 minute conversation and instantly know the 5 moments that’ll stop a scroll, and tell us why. You know the first 1 to 3 seconds decide everything. You live and breathe short-form growth on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and X, and you know what’s working on each right now. You can write a clip brief so clear an editor cuts it perfectly without asking you a thing. You make calls from data, not vibes. You get our audience, ambitious women building real businesses, and you can hold our voice. You move fast and you care about taste in equal measure.



Bonus, not essential: you can jump into CapCut yourself when needed, but this is a strategy role, we have an editor for the cutting.

title: The Sales Right Hand (Setter + Executive Assistant)
description:
Think... Sales Meets Founder's Secret Weapon



Let's be real for a second. Most sales support ads want someone to copy-paste scripts into DMs. Most EA ads want someone to book meetings and stay invisible. This is not that job. This is both jobs, done brilliantly, by one rare human.



At The Event Engineer, we help visionary entrepreneurs scale past the 7-figure mark by building world-class event systems. We don't do "average," and we don't do generic. We have an active pipeline, ongoing leads, and live events on the horizon, and right now, our founder, Lisa Barry, needs a true right hand across sales and her day-to-day.



We are looking for a rare human who is a 50/50 split between an Elite Sales Setter and a Meticulous Executive Assistant. If you get a little thrill from turning a cold DM into a booked call, chasing a warm lead until they say yes, and running a founder's calendar with zero clashes... welcome home.



Here's the best part: you will NOT be closing the clients. Lisa handles the final sales conversion. Your job is to fill her calendar with qualified, warm prospects and keep every deal moving. When she closes them, you win. Literally. There's a bonus with your name on it for every single deal.



What You'll Own (Your Playground):



THE SALES SIDE

Speed-to-Lead: Incoming chats, social DMs, and
 replies, answered fast. When a lead raises their hand, you're already typing. Fast responses win deals, and you take that personally.

Conversational Setting: Natural, human, text-based selling. You ask smart, open-ended questions, you understand buyer psychology, and you never sound like a script. You warm them up and book them onto Lisa's calendar, qualified and ready.

Follow-Up That Never Sleeps: The deal isn't done when the call ends. You own every lead after their sales call: keeping relationships warm, chasing invoices (charmingly), and moving every deal forward until it's closed or dead. No lead ever slips through the cracks on your watch.

Event Campaigns: Live events are our engine. You'll message event attendees, qualify the hot ones, and book them into the system.

GoHighLevel Pipeline Ownership: Everything lives in GHL, and your pipeline stays immaculate: stages, tasks, conversations, triggers and automations, all flawless. If a lead goes quiet, you notice before anyone else does.



THE EA SIDE

Lisa's Calendar: Book it, move it, protect it. You coordinate scheduling around sales calls, events and travel, and nothing ever double-books.

Her Inbox & Daily Details: You triage
, handle bookings, reminders and follow-up notes, and clear the small stuff before she has to think about it. You are the reason her day runs smoothly so she can stay focused on delivery and closing.

ClickUp: Your corner of our workspace stays current, so the team knows the state of the pipeline and the calendar at a glance.



Who You Are:

A Salesperson at Heart: You love the chase. A booked call feels like a win because it is one.

Lightning in Human Form: You physically cannot leave a message unanswered. Speed is your love language.

A Natural Conversationalist: Flawless written English. Warm, professional, and human. No rigid, robotic scripts. Ever.

An EA Instinct: You've protected a busy founder's or executive's time before. You anticipate, you don't wait.

An Autonomous Thinker: You see a quiet lead, a calendar clash, or an un-followed-up task and you immediately take action. Nobody has to tell you.



Qualifications:

Advanced GoHighLevel proficiency: pipelines, workflows, conversations, and triggers. You know GHL inside and out. Non-negotiable.

Proven sales setting, appointment setting, or inbound sales experience with real results

Executive assistant or founder-support experience

Flawless written English with a warm, natural, professional tone

ClickUp familiarity (or quick to learn)



The Vibes & The Package (Paid in AUD):

Location: 100% Remote (Based in the Philippines ????????)

Hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 P
lbourne time (Full-Time, matching Aussie hours!)

Base Pay: $1,000 AUD / month

Uncapped Close Bonus: A flat $50 AUD for every single deal Lisa closes that you set, followed up, or booked. No caps, no tiers, no fine print. You keep the pipeline moving, you get paid on every win.



A driven A-Player systematically working our leads and calendar can realistically clear well above their base every month as we scale the empire together.



How to Apply (No Generic AI Copy-Pasters Allowed! This is IMPORTANT)

We filter heavily for attention to detail, execution, and excellence. We want to see the real human behind the screen. If you send us a 100% ChatGPT-generated application, it goes straight to the trash.



To apply, send us:

Your Resume: Highlighting your specific experience with GoHighLevel, sales setting, follow-up, and executive assistant support.

Your Loom (1 to 2 minutes): Do not read an AI-generated script. Look directly into the camera and briefly tell us:

- A specific GoHighLevel pipeline or follow-up project you personally managed and optimized.

- The exact, natural sentence you would type to follow up with a warm lead who had a great sales call with the founder 3 days ago, but hasn't responded to the invoice yet.

- One example of how you've protected a busy founder's or executive's time (a system, a habit, or a save).

DISC Profile: Attach a screenshot or PDF of your DISC results (we love knowing how your brain ticks!).

Subject Line: Make the
 subject line: "[Your Name] | The Sales Right Hand"



Ready to become the founder's secret weapon? Apply now!

title: Real Estate Photography Quality Control & Editing Assistant (Part-Time)
description:
About Us



We are a real estate photography company based in Florida, USA. We have been in business for nearly 2 years and currently complete an average of 40–60 real estate photography shoots per month.



We are looking for a detail-oriented Real Estate Photography Quality Control & Editing Assistant (Part-Time) to review completed photos from our photo editors and ensure every image meets our quality standards before delivery to clients.







Job Responsibilities



Your main responsibility will be reviewing real estate photos and making final quality checks. Tasks include:



Review edited real estate photos for quality and consistency

Adjust brightness

Ensure wall colors, floors, and other surfaces look accurate and natural

Check that furniture, decorations, and objects have correct colors

Identify and fix small distractions in images, such as:

Wires/cables

Trash cans

Small clutter

Unwanted objects

Other distracting items

Make small Photoshop edits to improve the overall image

Ensure photos are clean, professional, and ready for client delivery







Requirements



Experience with Adobe Photoshop (required)

Experience with Lightroom (required)

Experience with real estate photography editing

Strong attention to detail and good visual judgment

Understanding of natural colors and realistic photo editing

Reliable internet connection







Work Schedule



Part-time position

Approximately 2–5 hours per day

Work hours will typically be 5:00 PM – 10:00 PM Philippines Time (PHT), Tuesday through Sunday.

Workload depends on the number of shoots completed

Each property usually takes around 1 hour to complete quality control (some may take less, some more)







Pay



You will be paid $6.50 USD for each shoot that you complete quality control on.

Each shoot typically takes around 1 hour to review and complete, but some shoots may take less or more time depending on the number of photos and required corrections.

Opportunity for long-term work and increased responsibilities as the company grows







How to Apply



Please include:

1. A brief introduction about yourself and your experience with photo editing. 

2. Are you available to work from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM Philippines Time, Tuesday through Sunday? 

3. Please provide examples of previous real estate photo editing work or a portfolio link (if available).

4. At the very bottom of your application, please write "I pay attention to details". Applications without this phrase will not be considered.



Applicants will be asked to complete a short photo quality control test during the hiring process.







We are looking for someone who takes pride in producing high-quality images and helping deliver the best possible results to our clients.

title: Video Editor
description:
About KLIK

KLIK is a DTC ecommerce brand built around a single, well-loved product: the KLIK Camera. It's a screen-free digital camera designed to bring back the feel of 90s film photography, without the film rolls or development wait.



Key features:

No preview screen.

No camera roll.

No notifications.

Shoot, stay present, and plug in via USB-C later to see what you captured.

Comes with 4 built-in film-emulation filters (Classic, Vintage, Black & White, and Film).

Holds up to 500 shots on one charge.

Weighs just 95g.



KLIK is rated 4.8 out of 5 across nearly 1,000 customer reviews and is sold globally at 
 in 7 colors. The brand targets people who want to disconnect from screens, capture real 
nts, and experience nostalgia — ideal for trips, parties, weddings, festivals, bonfires, and everyday adventures.



The video editor hired will produce DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) and UGC-style (User-Generated Content) ads that capture this brand identity: authentic, spontaneous, vintage-feeling, and scroll-stopping. The ads should be real and relatable, not overly polished.



About the Role

We are looking for a talented, self-driven Video Editor who specializes in creating high-performing DTC and UGC-style ecommerce video ads. This is a fully remote role offering flexible hours, allowing you to work from anywhere and set your own schedule, provided you consistently deliver high-quality output and are responsive to feedback. You will manage your own daily workload, with an expectation to produce a consistent volume of high-quality content.



You will work closely with a Creative Strategist as part of a small, focused pod. Together, you will produce, iterate, and refine ad creatives that drive real results for KLIK. Quality is the top priority — we would rather have someone with slightly more experience who delivers great work than someone cheap who delivers average work.



What You Will Be Doing

Produce 3–5 high-quality DTC / UGC-style video ads per day, depending on ad style and format.

Edit video content that is scroll-stopping, on-brand, and built to convert.

Capture the KLIK brand aesthetic in every edit — authentic, nostalgic, spontaneous, and fun.

Write or contribute to ad narratives, scripts, and hooks when needed (a plus, not a hard requirement).

Work closely with your assigned Creative Strategist to align on creative direction and output.

Process and implement feedback efficiently and accurately.

Iterate on creatives based on performance data and strategic direction.

Manage your daily workload and output to meet production targets, maintaining a consistent pace equivalent to a full-time commitment.

Deliver unique, original work — not repurposed or recycled content from existing ad libraries.



What We Are Looking For

Must-have:



Proven experience editing DTC and/or UGC-style ecommerce video ads.

Strong eye for what makes an ad hook, hold attention, and convert.

Ability to produce consistently high-quality work at volume — 3–5 ads per day.

Self-managed, reliable, and responsive to feedback.

Comfortable working independently with minimal hand-holding.

Own device capable of video editing and a stable internet connection.



Nice-to-have:

Experience writing ad narratives, hooks, or scripts.

Experience working within a creative pod or alongside a Creative Strategist.

Familiarity with ecommerce brand aesthetics and performance marketing.

Portfolio or examples of ads that have run and performed well.

An eye for nostalgic, film-style, or lifestyle content — aligns closely with the KLIK brand.



KLIK Brand Aesthetic — What to Keep in Mind

Understanding the KLIK brand is important for this role. The ads you produce should feel like:



Real 
nts — not staged or over-produced.

Nostalgic and film-like — vintage filter vibes, warm tones, grain.

Spontaneous and candid — trips, parties, bonfires, everyday life.

Emotionally resonant — content that makes people feel something and want to capture their own 
nts.

Scroll-stopping but authentic — hooks that feel natural, not clickbait.

Think: you're at a beach with friends, someone pulls out a KLIK, shoots without looking at the screen, and the photos come out beautifully imperfect. That feeling is what the ads should sell.



Tools

We have no preferred editing software. Use whatever tool you work best and fastest in. The output is what matters, not the tool. Commonly used options include Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, and Final Cut Pro — but we are not limited to these.



Compensation

Base Salary: $800–$1,500/month USD (based on experience and skill level).

We believe in paying well for great work. If you are experienced, fast, and consistently produce high-quality ads, we will compensate accordingly. A bonus structure is available for top-performing editors on top of the monthly base.



How We Work

Fully Remote: Work from anywhere, travel if you want.

Flexible Hours: You d
 when you work, as long as output is delivered.

Daily Output Expectation: 3–5 ads per working day.

Pod Model: You work alongside a Creative Strategist who reviews content and provides direction.

Feedback: Part of the process; expected to process and apply revisions quickly.

Quality at Volume: We prioritize great ads and expect high-quality output consistently, meeting daily production targets.

No Micromanagement: You own your output and your schedule.



Hiring Process

Application: Submit application form and portfolio/reel for review: 

Initial Interview: Background, experience, and fit assessment call.

Creative Test: Complete a video editing test. Must submit 100% original work, not from existing ad libraries.

Trial Period: Part-time or immediate hire depending on test outcome; performance evaluated.

1-Month Evaluation: Full output and quality evaluation over one month.

Full-time Offer: Hire confirmed based on evaluation, or engagement ends.

title: RPA Automation Architect (Microsoft Power Automate Desktop)
description:
Here is the complete job advertisement drafted for Onlinejobs.ph. It is structured to attract technical automation talent while filtering out general Virtual Assistants.



Job Title: RPA Automation Architect (Microsoft Power Automate Desktop)

Project Overview

I am seeking a highly skilled RPA (Robotic Process Automation) developer to build a modular, high-volume media production pipeline. The goal is to automate a 10-phase content creation workflow (scripting, AV mapping, and asset generation) using Microsoft Power Automate Desktop (PAD).



This is a technical build project, not a general administrative role. I need an architect who can design stable, locally-running automation that I can own and maintain.



Core Workflow Requirements

Phase 1 (Scripting): A modular flow that takes a video title/brief, interacts with Gemini via browser UI, and executes a 10-step prompt chain to produce a final script.



Phase 2 (AV Mapping): An automated process that converts the script into a structured AV table (Excel/CSV) with specific columns (Scene Number, Script, Asset Type, Image Prompt, Video Prompt).



Phase 3 (Asset Generation): A flow that reads the AV table and automates the interaction with external tools (Video Express/Google Flow) to generate assets and apply parallax effects.



Technical Requirements

Expert in Microsoft Power Automate Desktop (PAD): You must have a portfolio of flows you have built.



UI Automation Specialist: You prioritize using UI Elements and CSS Selectors over simple mouse-click coordinates to ensure automation stability when website layouts change.



Robust Logic: You build "defensive" automation that includes error handling—if a page loads slowly or a task fails, the bot should handle it gracefully without crashing.



Modular Architecture: You build clean, logical sub-flows that can be exported, imported, and run independently.



Project Deliverables & Budget

Total Budget: $375 – $500 USD (Milestone-based).



Milestone 1 (Proof of Concept): $150 USD. We will begin by building the Scripting & AV Table Automator. This must be a fully functional tool that I can use on my own machine immediately.



Milestone 2 (Full Build): $250 – $350 USD. Upon successful testing of Milestone 1, we will proceed to the Asset Generation flow.



Deliverables: Raw .flow source files and a brief setup guide/video showing me how to import and initialize the flows on my local workstation.



How to Apply

To be considered, please provide the following in your application:



Proof of Skill: A screenshot of a complex flow you have built in Power Automate Desktop, or a link to a video demonstrating a bot you created. (Applications without this will be ignored).



Methodology: Briefly explain how you ensure a PAD flow remains stable when a website interface updates.



Confirm Ability: Can you provide .flow files and assist with a remote import process?

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Customer Support Specialist

(Remote — Philippines-based)

Hours: 6:30am – 3:00pm AEST (daylight savings may apply)

About MachShip

MachShip is a fast-growing, cloud-based freight management platform that simplifies logistics for businesses across Australia. We connect shippers with carriers, streamline freight workflows, and help our customers take the complexity out of moving goods. Our team is collaborative, curious, and genuinely invested in the customer experience — and we're looking for someone who shares that energy.



About the Role

As a Customer Support Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for MachShip customers — responding to enquiries, diagnosing issues, and delivering fast, accurate, and empathetic support across our channels. This is a hands-on role where you'll develop deep platform knowledge, contribute to our knowledge base, and work closely with a high-performing support team.



You'll thrive here if you take genuine ownership of your work, communicate clearly under pressure, and approach every problem with curiosity and method. We use AI tools to work smarter, but your understanding always comes first.



What You'll Be Doing

• Responding to customer enquiries across
 and support channels in a timely, professional manner

• Accurately diagnosing and resolving common issues using documented processes, product knowledge, and available tools

• Escalating complex issues to Senior Specialists or Team Leaders with clear, detailed case notes — never passing on a ticket without full context

• Managing your personal ticket queue to SLA requirements, owning each ticket from open to resolution

• Building and maintaining product knowledge through onboarding, training, and self-directed learning

• Contributing to knowledge base articles by flagging gaps and suggesting improvements based on what you observe

• Documenting cases accurately and thoroughly in the ticketing system

• Using AI tools to draft, research, and improve quality — while always verifying content before it reaches a customer



What We're Looking For

Essential

• 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing support or technical support role

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — clear, professional, and empathetic

• Proactive by nature — you identify what needs doing and act on it without being asked

• Exceptional problem-solving skills — methodical, logical, and accurate under pressure

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in all written communications and case notes

• Ability to manage a busy ticket queue and prioritise effectively

• Comfortable learning and working across new software platforms (Zoho Desk, Zendesk, Jira or similar)

• Calm and composed when handling challenging or frustrated customer interactions

• Honest about knowledge limits — you know when to escalate, and you do it well



Desirable

• Experience in a SaaS or technology environment

• Exposure to logistics, freight, or supply chain platforms (e.g. Sendle, Transvirtual, Toll, Shipit)

• Familiarity with SLA-based ticketing systems and CRM platforms

• Tertiary qualification in IT, Business, Communications, or a related field



The Person We're Looking For

You communicate exceptionally well — whether it's a technical explanation, a difficult update to a frustrated customer, or a well-written case note that someone else can pick up instantly. You take initiative without waiting to be directed, and when something doesn't go to plan, your first instinct is to understand why and fix it properly.



You're curious about how things work and motivated to grow your technical knowledge over time. You understand that accuracy matters — and that a well-escalated ticket is always better than a rushed resolution. You're a team player who contributes beyond your own queue.



Hours: 6:30am – 3:00pm AEST, aligned with Australian business hours. Daylight savings may apply.

Please note: Skills testing will form part of the recruitment process for this role.



Our Values

• Delight Our Customers — everything we do shapes their experience

• Sweat the Small Stuff — progress comes from doing the details well

• One Team — we're all on the same side, solving shared problems

• Challenge With Curiosity — better outcomes come from good questions and respectful debate

• Go Hard or Go Home — we offer flexibility and trust, and expect energy, integrity, and ownership in return



How to Apply

If this sounds like the role for you, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your resume highlighting your relevant skills and experience.



Click on the link and submit application— including your work history, key skills, achievements, and contact information — in your resume for consideration. Applications without relevant experience or supporting detail included in resume may not be considered.



We review applications as they come in, so don't wait — apply now.

title: Book Keeper
description:
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented and reliable Bookkeeper to manage the day-to-day financial operations of our business. This role is critical in ensuring accurate financial records, smooth cash flow management, and effective coordination between internal teams and external advisors.



The successful candidate will have experience working with Xero, practice management systems such as Splose, and bank integrations, with strong reconciliation and organisational skills.



Key Responsibilities:



Accounts & Bookkeeping:

1. Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records in Xero

2. Process accounts payable and receivable - this is currently undertaken by our administrative team, the bookkeeper would assist in the reconciliation process as the invoices are issued automatically from Splose once the therapy session is completed.

3. Prepare and issue invoices, and follow up on outstanding payments - as noted above

4. Manage payroll processing (This is currently done internally by our Operations manager and an external payroll provider, you will be required to assist and eventually take over the operations manager input into the payroll) 

5. Assist with BAS preparation and compliance (in conjunction with the external accountant) 

6. EOFY preparation and assisting the external accountant with all requirements

7. Keeping track of all ATO and state revenue payment plans and commitments

8. Financial and business forecasting of income vs expenditure

9. Creating and maintaining yearly financial forecast vs actuals of budgets, forecasts vs actuals, tracked daily, reported monthly and revised yearly.





Banking & Reconciliation:

1. Manage and monitor Commonwealth Bank integrations with Xero

2. Perform daily and monthly bank reconciliations

3. Reconcile credit cards and other financial accounts

4. Investigate and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner

5. Keeping a real-time record of funds coming in vs going out of the business

6. Maintaining cash flows

7. Keeping the directors advised on the financial position of the business at any given time.



Systems & Software:

1. Work across Xero and Splose (practice management software) to ensure accurate syncing of financial data

2. Ensure the correct allocation of payments, invoices, and client records between systems 

3. Identify and resolve integration or data inconsistencies between platforms

4. Microsoft Office systems – Excel, Word, etc

 



Reporting & Compliance:

1. Prepare regular financial reports (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet) for management

2. Assist in budgeting and financial forecasting

3. EOFY reporting and assistance to the external accountant

4. Ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures

5. Maintain organised and audit-ready financial records in the company one drive and Xero (invoices storage)



Stakeholder Liaison:

1. Liaise with internal admin and operations staff to ensure accurate billing and data entry for all payment methods, NDIS, Eftpos, Stripe, plan managers, and Cash  

2. Work closely with the external accountant to support tax compliance, reporting, and year-end processes

3. Provide financial insights and support to management as required

4. Qualifications & Requirements



Skills & Experience:

1. Proven experience in a bookkeeping or similar role

2. Strong working knowledge of Xero (essential)

3. Experience with Splose or similar practice management systems (highly regarded)

4. Experience with bank integrations, particularly Commonwealth Bank

5. High level of accuracy and attention to detail

6. Strong organisational and time management skills

7. Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills

8. Strong Microsoft Office systems experience 

9. Strong experience in using drop box, One Drive, 

10. Strong forecasting and budgeting skills 



Personal Attributes:

1. Reliable, proactive and accountable

2. Ability to work independently and as part of a team

3. Strong problem-solving skills

4. Discreet and able to handle confidential information



Desirable:

1. Certificate IV in Bookkeeping or Accounting (or equivalent)

2. Experience in healthcare or allied health industry (preferred but not essential)

3. Minimum of 5 years’ experience



Non - Negotiable Requirements

1. Proven experience in a bookkeeping or similar role

2. Certificate IV in Bookkeeping or Accounting (or equivalent)

3. Strong working knowledge of Xero (essential)

4. Experience with bank integrations, particularly Commonwealth Bank

title: CAD Engineer
description:
The client designs and manufactures engine-mounted compressor and alternator drive kits, mounting brackets

and related components for refrigerated transport. The CAD engineer reverse-engineers, designs and details

these parts so they can be manufactured and fitted correctly first time, and delivers all design data into

the client's ownership in editable form. The role covers laser-cut steel brackets, machined components and

castings, along with the assembly drawings, bills of material, exploded views and fitting manuals that go with

them.



Output drives real production and customer fitment, so fit, dimensional accuracy and clear, manufacturable

drawings matter more than speed.



Inputs (what the engineer receives)



? A Ramair part number (RMxxxx) issued before any new part is started, with the part modelled, drawn and

filed to that number.

? A design brief covering the application: compressor or alternator model, belt arrangement, pulley

specification, mounting interface, target vehicle or engine, and the product line it belongs to (for example a

Euro 6 variant, an alternator mount kit, or a TCCI QP30 conversion).

? 3D scan data of the target engine, compressor or vehicle interface, supplied as raw scan or mesh, to

design the part around.

? Physical or in-production samples, photographs and hand measurements where a scan is not available or

needs confirming.

? Reference material: existing similar kits, the relevant native files (DXF or Parasolid) from the Engineering

Folder for revisions, prior BOMs and install guides.

? Component and interface specifications: compressor mounting patterns, pulley dimensions, fastener

standards, and any supplier constraints from the laser cutter, machinist or foundry.

? Ramair drawing templates (A4 and A3), title blocks and the part numbering convention.

Activities (the work expected)

? Clean and interpret 3D scan data into usable reference geometry for design.

? Design laser-cut brackets, machined parts (drive pulleys, fan spacers, spacer blocks) and castings,

modelled in 3D and built to be edited and revised cleanly.

? Engineer the spacer stack, compressor or alternator position, pulley plane and belt alignment so the

assembly is correct and serviceable.

? Produce manufacturing data in the correct format for each part type, as set out under Outputs.

? Create detail drawings with full dimensions, tolerances, materials, finishes and machining operations.

? Create general assembly drawings showing what goes where, with spacer diameters and lengths called

out explicitly.

? Generate bills of material and exploded views, and produce graphics for assembly and fitting manuals.

? Apply design-for-manufacture judgement and resolve queries with suppliers so parts are made without

avoidable back-and-forth.

? Incorporate changes found during first production or sample checks, and keep every revision controlled.

? Maintain and tidy the Ramair drawing templates, fastener and part libraries and naming, improving them

over time.

? Over time, support two programmes: re-mastering the existing active range into clean editable models,

and digitising newly acquired product ranges.



CAD Engineer | Role description



Outputs (what the engineer delivers)



For every part, the editable native CAD and the matching PDF, delivered into the Ramair Engineering Folder

under the assigned RM number, never as a sole copy held elsewhere.



? Laser-cut brackets: individual DXF files for cutting, a detail drawing (PDF) for each, and a general

assembly or detail drawing (PDF) for manufacture and assembly.

? Castings: two Parasolid models, machined and unmachined, a detail drawing (PDF) for machining

operations and tolerances, and a general assembly drawing (PDF).

? Machined items (drive pulleys, fan spacers, spacer blocks): a Parasolid 3D model and a detail

drawing (PDF).

? Assemblies: a 3D assembly model, a bill of material in a structured format (spreadsheet or CSV), and

exploded views (PDF or image, with the source assembly file retained).

? Manuals: exploded views and step graphics suitable for assembly and fitting instructions, generated once

a design is tested and finalised.

? Revision control: CAD and PDF always issued at the same matched revision, with a short changelog

noting what changed.



Where the working software allows, the parametric source file is delivered as well as the neutral formats, so

Ramair holds fully editable design data.



Quality criteria



Good looks like



? The part fits first time. Mounting points, interface to the scanned geometry, belt alignment and pulley

planes are all correct.

? The spacer stack is fully resolved, with spacer diameters and lengths stated clearly and correctly. This is

the single most common failure point and must be right.

? Drawings are unambiguous, fully dimensioned and toleranced sensibly, and the part can be made exactly

as drawn.

? Tolerances are appropriate to function, tight where it matters and open where it does not, so cost is not

driven up needlessly.

? CAD and PDF match at the same revision every time, filed correctly to the RM number with native files

included.

? Models are clean and structured so the next change is quick to make.

? Exploded views and manual graphics are clear enough to fit from without guesswork.

Bad looks like

? The part needs rework to fit, has missing or wrong mounting points, or causes belt misalignment.

? Spacer dimensions are missing, wrong or only discoverable by measuring the model.

? Drawings are under-dimensioned, untoleranced or not manufacturable as drawn.

? CAD and PDF are out of step, or a revision is issued without updating both.

? Only PDFs are delivered, or native files are withheld or filed in the wrong place.

? The numbering convention or templates are ignored.

? Models are messy and cannot be revised without rebuilding.

Because these parts sit inside the OEM warranty position that protects Ramair's market, a part that does not

fit has real downstream cost at the dealer. Changes that affect fit are validated against a sample before

release.



Timeframes (indicative turnaround, to be confirmed)



These are starting points, measured from when the part number, brief and scan data are provided, and should

be set against Ramair's real cadence. The clock does not start until inputs are complete. Missing scan data,

samples or a part number pauses the timeframe.

Other expectations



? Ownership of work product: all designs, models, drawings, scan-derived geometry and source files are

Ramair's intellectual property. The engineer signs an IP assignment and confidentiality agreement,

delivers all native and source files into Ramair's repository, and retains no sole copies.

? Toolset: work is done in a mainstream CAD package that reads 3D scan data and exports Parasolid and

DXF cleanly (for example SolidWorks, Inventor, Solid Edge or Fusion). Ramair owns or standardises the

licensing and file formats so the work is portable and the role can scale or change hands without

recreating files. The design data must never be locked to one person's private licence or machine.

? Version control and filing: incremental versioning, matched CAD and PDF, a changelog, and consistent

filing to the RM numbering scheme in the Engineering Folder.

? Validation: work to a simple change-control process and support sample checks before a changed part

goes live.

? Communication: responsive asynchronous communication across time zones, clear acknowledgement

of briefs, and weekly visibility of work in progress and queue.

? Confidentiality: designs, customer information and the fitment and warranty sensitivities are treated as

commercially confidential.

? Capacity to scale: able to absorb a backlog over time, including re-mastering the existing range into

editable models, the fitting-manuals programme, and digitising newly acquired product lines.

title: Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research
description:
Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines (Metro Manila or Cebu preferred for talent network access)

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a senior operations leader to take ownership of our CATI call floor — and to help shape what comes next. This is a senior, long-term partnership with a genuine strategic dimension, and the package reflects that:



• Lead the bridge to AI-assisted interviewing — the role includes contributing to a voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Detail below.

• Direct line to the COO — you’ll report straight to the Chief Operating Officer of TKW Research Group. No middle layers.

• Base retainer: ?130,000 – ?180,000 PHP per month, commensurate with seniority, paid in arrears.

• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.

• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing dialler, CATI platform, and methodology training so you can perform at the highest level.

• Real ownership of how the floor runs, working directly with senior ANZ leadership — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We run multi-market CATI fieldwork for ANZ and international market research clients, and we’re looking for an experienced operations manager to take ownership of the call floor. You’ll be responsible for fieldwork execution, dialler performance, quota management, and the productivity of our interviewer teams.



This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You’ll have real autonomy over how the floor runs, but you’re also expected to roll up your sleeves — personally running shifts when needed and working directly with front-line interviewers, not just managing through layers. You’ll be accountable for hitting completion targets, maintaining quality, and keeping projects on budget.



The Hybrid Future — What Makes This Different



Every senior CATI manager knows what’s coming. Voicebots are going to reshape telephone interviewing within the next few years, and operations leaders fall into two camps: those who get sidelined by it, and those who lead the transition. We’re looking for the second kind.



TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that can conduct natural-sounding interviews at scale. Your role in this isn’t theoretical: as the voicebot moves from pilot to production, you’ll be the operational lead running the blended human/voicebot floor. D
 which interviews go to human interviewers and which go to the voicebot. Managing quality across both channels. Calibrating the hybrid model to deliver better data than either could alone.



If you’ve been waiting for a CATI role where you get to shape what telephone research becomes — rather than manage its slow decline — this is it.



What You’ll Do



• Manage CATI fieldwork end-to-end: sample distribution, quota matrices, completion tracking.

• Monitor dialler performance in real time — contact rates, call dispositions, interviewer yield — and make tactical calls to keep productivity up.

• Coordinate Shift Supervisors, QA staff, and a remote interviewer pool.

• Troubleshoot operational issues live and work directly with the survey programming team when scripts need adjustments.

• Maintain ISO 20252 / ESOMAR-aligned quality processes.

• Produce daily and weekly operational reporting for the COO.

• 7+ years in CATI operations within a market research agency or fieldwork BPO, with 3+ years in a senior management role.

2. The dialler platforms you know best.

3. Your shift flexibility.

4. Your view on how voicebots will reshape telephone interviewing — and where you see your role in that shift.

title: Real estate photography cold caller
