Volume: roughly 20–30 dials per day

Tools: OpenPhone (you'll call from our business line — we provide access), and tracking in CRM.

You get: scripts, prepped call sheets with agent names and listing details, and direct feedback from the owner



Compensation

Starting at $3/hr depending on experience

Plus commission on every shoot you book — commission scales with the package size, so bigger bookings mean bigger payouts

Bonus for total monthly  bookings

30-day paid trial period, rates reviewed at 90 days based on results



What we need from you:

Neutral or near-neutral English accent — this is a hard requirement, our clients are US real estate agents

Confident, warm phone presence; comfortable with rejection and keeping energy up

Prior cold calling or phone sales experience (real estate ISA/appointment-setting experience is a big plus)

Experience booking appointments live during calls — able to check availability, quote package pricing, and lock in a date/time without breaking conversational flow

Reliable internet + quiet workspace + quality headset

Consistent availability during the stated US Central hours

Coachable — you'll get call recording feedback weekly

How to apply (read carefully — applications missing these will not be reviewed)



 
 your proposal with the word SKYLINE so we know you read this.

Attach a voice recording (60–90 seconds): introduce yourself, then read the following as if you were on a live call:

"Hey, is this Sarah? Hey Sarah, this is [your name] with Real Media here in Nashville — I'm actually reaching out about your listing over on Elmington Avenue. Great looking property. We work with a lot of agents in the area on their listing photos and video, and I'd love to tell you real quick how we could help that one stand out. Do you have a second?"

Briefly describe your cold calling experience and your typical results (calls per hour, appointments booked, etc.).

Confirm you can work the US Central time windows listed above.

title: Creative Founder’s Assistant
description:
I’m a creative entrepreneur building several connected projects, including a personalized gifting business, a corporate gifting service, and a local newsletter.



I’m looking for a resourceful, creative person who can help turn early-stage ideas into clear, practical and actionable projects.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role where you simply wait for detailed instructions. You will often be given a goal, idea or problem and expected to research it, think through it and help move it forward.



THE IDEAL PERSON



You are someone who:

- Has built, launched, or meaningfully contributed to something before

- Is a strong researcher and can find useful, reliable information

- Can turn research into recommendations and next steps

- Enjoys developing ideas but can also organize and execute them

- Is comfortable working with incomplete instructions

- Naturally looks for solutions and takes initiative

- Communicates clearly and follows through

- Uses AI and digital tools thoughtfully, without relying on generic output



What you have built does not need to be a large business. It could be a product, event, website, newsletter, campaign, community, system or personal project.

- Organize projects, track next steps and follow up on outstanding tasks

- Help prepare briefs for designers, writers or other collaborators

- Handle occasional administrative and founder-support tasks



THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

- Need detailed step-by-step instructions for every task

- Prefer only repetitive administrative work

- Generate ideas but struggle to finish projects

- Send research without explaining what it means or what should happen next

- Wait for permission before taking reasonable next steps



HELPFUL SKILLS

- Online and market research

- Writing and summarizing information

- Creative thinking and concept development

- Project coordination

- Product or supplier sourcing

- Notion, Trello, ClickUp or similar tools

- AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity



Strong written English and clear communication are required.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please complete the application form at this link:

AI tools are welcome, but generic AI-generated answers that do not show your own thinking will not strengthen your application.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER (GHL SPECIALIST)

Go Ignite  |  Fully Remote  |  Monday-Friday  |  7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

PHP 80,000/month + OTE  |  Prepaid HMO  |  Paid Time Off



If you can build a full GHL white label environment from scratch, run paid ads that convert, and own results end-to-end -- read on. 



If you have never led a team, need hand-holding, prefer to execute someone else's strategy, or are not ready to commit to a full 8-hour day with an international team -- this role is not for you.



Go Ignite is hiring one person for this role. We are not filling a seat. We are building our internal digital engine, and we need someone who has done this before at a high level.



This role is NOT for you if:

You have only used GHL as an end-user - proven sub-account builds, white label setups, and A2P/10DLC experience are required

You have never managed paid campaigns for Australian or US-based clients

You cannot show us real outcomes: funnels you built, ads you ran, metrics that moved

You are looking for someone to tell you what to do every day

You have never led, coordinated, or managed a marketing team or direct reports

 

About Go Ignite

Go Ignite is the growth and technology division of a specialist international recruitment group connecting top Filipino talent with high-growth Australian and US businesses. We build the systems -- the funnels, automations, and campaigns - that power candidate attraction and client conversion at scale. This is an internal hire. You will own the tools that drive the business.



The Role

You will lead the Go Ignite marketing function. The marketing team reports directly to you, giving leadership full visibility without day-to-day involvement. You own the GHL ecosystem, drive paid campaign performance, and set the standard for how the team executes and grows. This is a player-coach role -- you build, you lead, and you are accountable for results.



These are the five areas you will own:



Team Leadership & Direction

Lead and coordinate the Go Ignite marketing team -- you are the go-to for direction, prioritisation, and performance

Set weekly priorities, run team check-ins, and ensure campaigns and systems are moving without requiring escalation to the owner

Build and maintain SOPs so the team operates to a consistent standard and scales without bottlenecks

Report to the business owner on team performance, key wins, and strategic recommendations.



GHL Systems & Automation

Full white label environment management: sub-account setup, affiliate manager configuration, A2P/10DLC registration and compliance

Build and maintain lead generation funnels, automation workflows, nurture sequences, appointment booking flows, and CRM pipelines from scratch

Provide technical support and troubleshoot across workflows, deliverability, domains, and third-party integrations

Develop SOPs and documentation so systems scale without you as a single point of failure.



Paid Advertising

Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta 
/Instagram), Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube -- ad creatives and copy are supplied by the team

A/B test audiences, landing pages, and ad sets using performance data and AI-driven insights

Manage CPL, ROAS, and conversion targets across Australian and US market campaigns



Web, Integrations & Landing Pages

Maintain WordPress sites: forms, tracking pixels, domain configuration, webhooks, Zapier integrations

Build high-converting landing pages that support campaign objectives



Analytics, Reporting & Social

Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports across GHL dashboards, Google Analytics, and ad platforms

Support social media content scheduling and brand presence using AI tools and content calendars

Recommend improvements across funnels, paid ads, and
/SMS campaigns based on data. 



What You Must Bring

3+ years hands-on experience as a GHL Specialist or Digital Marketer -- not as a VA who uses GHL, but as someone who builds in it

Proven full white label GHL setup experience: sub-account creation, affiliate manager config, A2P/10DLC registration

Demonstrated paid ads results on Meta and/or Google Ads for Australian or US clients -- you have screenshots, ROAS data, or client outcomes to show us

WordPress integration skills: pixels, tracking, domains, webhooks, Zapier

Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, or similar) for content and automation tasks

Excellent written and spoken English -- you communicate directly with an international team daily

Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating a marketing team -- you know how to set direction, give feedback, and drive accountability

Self-directed, organised, and able to manage multiple campaigns and people without daily supervision

 

Why This Role Stands Apart



Most GHL roles in the Philippines are VA-level: follow the SOP, raise a ticket, wait for approval. This is not that.

You own the GHL ecosystem -- architecture decisions are yours

You work directly with the leadership team, not through layers of management

You see the full picture: how funnels feed ads, how ads feed the pipeline, how the pipeline drives revenue

You lead the marketing team -- this is a genuine step into a Head of Marketing function

International exposure with Australian and US market campaigns -- resume-building work with real accountability 

Compensation & Benefits



PHP 80,000/month base + OTE

Base salary: PHP 80,000/month. On-target earnings (OTE) are payable on top of base, tied to agreed performance outcomes. Total compensation for a strong performer exceeds base.

Prepaid HMO (ask us about dependent coverage options)

Paid Time Off

Fully remote -- work from anywhere in the Philippines

Full-time, 40 hours/week | Monday-Friday | 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

Direct access to leadership and real career growth as the business scales



How to Apply

We review every application personally. We do not shortlist candidates who skip these steps.

1. Your updated CV

2. A 2-3 minute video introduction: who you are, why this role is the right next step, and a walkthrough of one GHL build you are proud of

3. Your portfolio -- funnels, automations, ad campaign results,
 sequences -- anything with measurable outcomes (Google Drive, Notion, or Loom links are fine).

4. A written answer to the screening question below, included in your application message

Screening Question (required):

Walk us through a GHL white label setup you have completed end-to-end. What did the configuration involve? How did you handle A2P/10DLC registration? What did the finished client environment look like, and what were the results for the client?



Applications without a written answer to this question will not be reviewed.

If your application is strong, you will hear from us within 3-5 business days.

description:

Details about the position:



- $1000 to $2000 USD per month!



- Work from home!



- 9AM to 6PM Eastern Time - Monday to Friday!

------------------------

REQUIREMENTS



- Fully fluent in English, both spoken and written.



- Previous experience building automations using Make, Zapier or n8n.



- Previous experience using an AI coding agent such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.



You should be comfortable using coding agents to work on repos inside GitHub, make changes, troubleshoot issues, and confirm that the final result works correctly.



A significant part of this role will involve using coding agents to build and improve reusable skills, instructions, and workflows that will be used by AI agents.



- Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, basic scripts, and AI-agent tools such as MCP servers.



You do not need to be an expert in every term listed above. The more you understand, the better, but we can teach specific tools if you have strong fundamentals.



We do not require you to know how to code, but it is a bonus. You do not need to be a professional software developer, but you should understand how different tools communicate with each other and be able to troubleshoot integrations when something goes wrong.

- Previous programming or software-development experience

- Experience writing or modifying scripts

- Experience with Google Sheets, Google Forms, Google Drive, Airtable, ClickUp, or GoHighLevel

- Experience with AI image and video tools such as GPT Image, Kling, Seedance, Grok Imagine, or similar models

- Experience with agents such as Hermes and OpenClaw



You do not need experience with every tool we use. We can teach you our specific systems and workflows, but you must already have hands-on experience with AI coding agents, automation platforms, and AI-powered workflows.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



Your main responsibility would be to automate repetitive processes in the company using mainly AI agents, and some Make/Zapier automations as well.

- Building and improving AI-agent skills, instructions, and workflows.

- Automating the generation of AI ads using image/video AI models.

- Automating the onboarding of new clients.

- Automating some of our copywriter's tasks.

- Automating the tracking of all our data.



We already have A LOT of automations + AI workflows set up - you'd be coming into an already existing system. Your goal would be to improve it and keep it up to date.

COMPANY INFORMATION



We are a marketing company that specializes in Meta Ads (among other things)



You would help us automate tasks and processes so that we can create more ads for ourselves and our clients!



Last year, we generated over 35,000 leads - you will be contributing to our efforts this year, where we aim to break this goal!

So if you're someone who's:



1 - An overachiever

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success and Tech Support) - $900 p/m + Bonuses (Up to $1,400 p/m)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Dropshipping Supply Chain Management
description:
About the role

We run 25+ Shopify stores across the UK, US, Australia, and Europe, working with three fulfillment suppliers. Every day, a share of our orders hits a problem — a product goes out of stock, a shipment stalls, a customer types the wrong address. Those orders sit in a supplier sheet until someone chases them down and closes them out. That person is you.

This is not a passive data-entry job. You will be pushing suppliers, sourcing alternatives, and talking to customers until each issue is genuinely resolved — not just logged.

What you'll do

Own the supplier sheet. Work your assigned supplier's issue queue daily (Sourcing Issues, High Cost, Address & Delivery, Shipping Issues, Need Resend, Refunds). Every row gets a status, an action, and an outcome. No order sits untouched.

Resolve sourcing issues. When a product can't be sourced through the assigned supplier, find it elsewhere — alternative suppliers, Alibaba, 1688, Taobao — at an acceptable cost and lead time, and get the order moving.

Handle out-of-stock products. Identify OOS items fast, secure a replacement source or a comparable substitute, and escalate to the manager when a product needs to be pulled from the store instead.

Chase shipping issues until they're closed. Stuck shipments, missing tracking, delayed handovers, lost parcels. Follow up with the supplier on a fixed cycle and keep pushing — politely and persistently — until you have a real answer, not a "we're checking."

Contact customers directly. Reach out on order inquiries: incorrect or incomplete addresses, pickup arrangements, delivery reschedules, substitution approvals. Get the information needed to complete the order, and keep the tone professional and reassuring.

Escalate on time. Anything that breaches its follow-up deadline goes to the Senior Manager with a clear summary of what's been tried.

What we're looking for



Strong written English — you'll be
ing suppliers and messaging customers all day

Comfortable in Google Sheets (filters, statuses, structured data)

Persistent by nature — the kind of person who sends the fourth follow-up without being asked

Organized enough to hold 50+ open issues in a system, not in your head

E-commerce, dropshipping, logistics, or customer service experience preferred

Available to overlap with supplier working hours (China time zone) and respond within the same day



Nice to have



Experience sourcing on Alibaba / 1688 / Taobao

Familiarity with Shopify order management

Prior work with CJdropshipping or similar fulfillment platforms



What success looks like after 90 days

Your supplier's issue queue is under control. Nothing is older than its SLA. Customers hear from you before they have to ask twice. Out-of-stock products get replaced or removed within days, not weeks.

To apply

Send your CV and a short note answering one question: describe a time you had to chase someone repeatedly to get something resolved, and how you did it.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:



- Company
 Page:





[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

title: ADVICE ASSOCIATE  (URGENT - FINANCIAL ADVICE EXPERIENCE )
description:
ADVICE ASSOCIATE - FINANCIAL ADVICE INDUSTRY (APPLY IF WITH EXPERIENCE)

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Salary: AUD$10-$15ph



ABOUT LIFE UNSHACKLED

LifeUnshackled is a platform built to help people reclaim the life they once dreamed of, clients and team alike. We exist because “retire comfortably” is not the goal, freedom is. We bring bold financial strategy and strong follow-through so clients can build real wealth and live life on their terms. You will be joining a growth-minded team that cares about ambition, high standards, and doing work that genuinely helps people unshackle their lives.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The Associate is the operational and relational lead for their assigned clients, acting as the Chief Operating Officer of each client relationship. This role combines precision in data and document management, project management discipline, people and communication skills, hands-on platform execution, and a delegation mindset. Each Associate is responsible for ensuring timely, compliant, and high-quality delivery of financial advice implementation and client outcomes, in coordination with the broader LifeUnshackled team.



FOUR KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITIES

1. The Information Steward

- Custodian of all essential client information and access rights.

- Curate and maintain a “Client Support Pack” with critical data and supporting documents for rapid use in preparing application forms. This includes identity documents (individuals and entities), FATCA, ABNs, ACNs, TFNs, ESAs, bank accounts, wholesale certificates, etc.

- Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements).

- Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times.

- Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence.

- Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly.

- Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms.

- Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management.

- Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?”



2. The Delivery Project Manager

- Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines.

- Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval.

- Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks.

- Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution.

- Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome.

- Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals.

- Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties.

- Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?”



3. The Relationship Anchor

- Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client.

- Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly.

- Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients.

- Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life.

- Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings.

- Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal.

- Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting.

- Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates.

- Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?”



4. The Compliant Storyteller

- Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story.

- Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes.

- Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up
s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information.

- Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised.

- Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions.

- Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals.

- Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered.

- Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?”



PRIORITISATION ORDER

- From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order:

- Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction.

- Insurance applications and getting policies into force.

- Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting
s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser.

- Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour).

- Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding).

- Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc).

- Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority.

- Anything you can’t get to in a reasonable time, just flag it, and we can try to delegate to others or make a business decision to defer that task.



REPORTING & COLLABORATION

Reports to: Practice Support Manager (PSM) for delivery oversight; Principal Adviser for client outcomes.

Collaborates with: PSM, Paraplanner, Admin Assistant, Principal Adviser.



Indicators of Success

- 100% of clients have complete, current documentation and adviser access.

- Tasks are delivered on time with minimal Principal intervention.

- High service ratings and positive feedback from assigned clients.

- Accurate and timely handoff of technical and administrative work.

- Adviser’s administrative workload is reduced for each client in your portfolio.

- Investment transactions executed same-day; insurance applications commenced within 48 hours.

- Demonstrated proficiency across all required platforms.



Expected Behaviour

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable.

- Thoughtful and detail-oriented.

- Able to prioritise and escalate as needed.

- Collaborative, not siloed.

- Focused on both client satisfaction and internal efficiency.



APPLICATION PROCESS

To apply, please submit the following:

• A 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are the best fit for this role

• Your updated CV and LinkedIn profile link

• Names and contact details of three references (2 professional + 1 personal)



Please apply and
 all details to: 

ONLY those who follow the instructions in how to apply will be accommodated.

title: Estimator
description:
Remote Xactimate Estimator



Company: Paul Davis Restoration of Miami Beach

Location: Remote 



Position Overview



Paul Davis Restoration is seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Remote Xactimate Estimator to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience preparing insurance restoration estimates using Xactimate and be capable of producing accurate, well-supported estimates for water, mold, fire, storm, and reconstruction projects.



This position requires someone who can work independently, communicate effectively in English, meet aggressive turnaround times, and confidently defend estimate decisions with insurance carriers, adjusters, and internal tea
mbers.



Our goal is to produce estimates that are technically accurate, complete, and maximize all legitimate scope while remaining fully supported by industry standards.



?



Primary Responsibilities



Prepare complete Xactimate estimates for mitigation and reconstruction projects.

Review photos, sketches, moisture reports, scopes of work, and field notes to develop accurate estimates.

Submit completed estimates within 24 hours of receiving an assignment whenever possible.

Complete estimate revisions requested by insurance carriers within 24 hours.

Respond promptly to requests from project managers and office staff.

Upload estimates to XactAnalysis and carrier portals when required.

Maintain organized estimate files and documentation.

Identify missing scope items before submitting estimates.

Ensure all line items are justified and supported by the project documentation.

Communicate with our team regarding questions or missing information.

Assist in supplementing estimates when additional damage is identified.

Review carrier estimates and identify omissions, underpayments, and opportunities for supplements.

Maintain consistency with Paul Davis estimating standards and insurance best practices.



?



Required Qualifications



Xactimate



Minimum 2 years of professional Xactimate estimating experience

Strong knowledge of:

Sketch

Macros

Price Lists

Variables

Categories

F9 notes

Estimate organization

ESX importing/exporting

XactAnalysis



Construction Knowledge



The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of residential construction and restoration methods, including:



Drywall

Insulation

Painting

Flooring

Tile installation

Baseboards and trim

Cabinets

Plumbing fixtures

Electrical fixtures

Roofing fundamentals

Water mitigation procedures

Mold remediation scope

Demolition procedures



Candidates should understand how building assemblies are constructed so they can properly include all required line items—not simply replace visible finishes.



For example, when estimating flooring, the estimator should recognize when additional items such as mortar beds, underlayment, waterproofing, transitions, trim, floor preparation, or other associated components are required.



?



Required Skills



Excellent attention to detail

Strong analytical thinking

Ability to read construction plans and sketches

Ability to identify missing scope items

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Strong organizational skills

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Excellent time management

Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

Strong problem-solving skills

Professional written and spoken English



?



Communication Requirements



Applicants must be proficient in English.



The estimator will communicate daily with project managers regarding scopes of work, revisions, estimate questions, and supplement opportunities. Clear written and verbal communication is essential.



?



Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will consistently:



Complete new estimates within 24 hours

Complete revisions within 24 hours

Produce accurate and defensible estimates

Minimize missed line items

Meet deadlines without sacrificing quality

Support estimate decisions with Xactimate best practices and construction knowledge

Be available during agreed-upon business hours for communication



?



Preferred Qualifications



IICRC certifications (WRT, ASD, FSRT, AMRT, etc.)

Experience estimating for restoration contractors

Experience working with insurance carriers

Experience with managed repair programs (MRP)

Experience preparing supplements

Knowledge of insurance claim workflows

Familiarity with Matterport, EagleView, or other estimating technologies



?



What Success Looks Like



A successful estimator on our team:



Produces accurate estimates the first time.

Thinks like a construction professional, not just a software operator.

Anticipates missing scope before the estimate is submitted.

Helps maximize legitimate claim value by capturing every necessary line item.

Works efficiently without sacrificing quality.

Communicates proactively.

Takes ownership of every estimate from start to finish.



We value quality over speed—but expect both. Our ideal estimator is someone our project managers can trust to deliver complete, professional estimates that require minimal revisions and stand up to insurance scrutiny.

title: Junior Phone Support Executive Assistant/Leasing Agent (WFH)
description:
Are you someone who enjoys speaking with people and wants a stable, long-term work-from-home career?



We're hiring a Junior Phone Support / Executive Assistant to join our growing U.S. property management team.



Previous property management experience is not required. We believe the right attitude is more important than industry experience, and we're happy to train someone who is motivated, dependable, and eager to learn.



If you have a professional phone presence, enjoy helping people, and are looking for a company where you can grow over time, we'd love to hear from you.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



-Friendly, approachable, and professional when speaking with customers

-Comfortable talking to different people throughout the day

-Dependable and consistent with attendance and communication

-Organized and able to manage several tasks at once

-Open to learning new tools, systems, and processes

-Takes pride in producing quality work

-Able to work independently after completing training

-Interested in building a long-term career rather than simply finding another job



AVAILABILITY



-Available to work Monday through Friday during U.S. Pacific Time business hours

-Primary phone coverage is from 6:00 AM to 4:00 PM (U.S. Pacific Time)

-Able to answer calls and respond promptly during scheduled work hours

-Occasionally available to assist outside your regular schedule when reasonably possible



In this role, success is measured by your reliability, responsiveness, communication skills, and sense of responsibility—not by how many hours you spend sitting at your computer. At times, phone coverage may be handled using your mobile phone when appropriate.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Property management knowledge isn't necessary, we'll provide training for the right person. However, we're looking for someone who already understands what it's means to work in a professional environment.



Non-negotiable Requirements:

-Previous work-from-home experience

-At least 2 years of experience (not combined experience) working for a company in customer service, BPO, administration, hospitality, or a similar role

-Excellent written and spoken English

-A confident, professional phone voice and comfort speaking with people throughout the day

-Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace

-Available to work U.S. Pacific Time hours

-Positive attitude and willingness to learn



THIS POSITION MAY NOT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF...



-You don't enjoy speaking with people or delivering excellent customer service

-You prefer reading from a script instead of having genuine conversations

-You need frequent supervision or reminders to complete your work

-You're only looking for a temporary job or short-term opportunity

-You're expecting this position to quickly transition into management or an entirely different career path. As a small company, this role provides experience across different areas of the business while allowing you to develop valuable skills.

-You prefer a role where you simply complete assigned hours without taking ownership or initiative



ABOUT OUR COMPANY



-We're a growing U.S.-based property management company that values and supports our team

-We're looking for someone who wants to stay and grow with us for the long term

-We believe in reliability, accountability, kindness, and doing the right thing

-If you enjoy helping others and take pride in your work, you'll fit right in



COMPENSATION



-Full-Time Remote Position

-Independent Contractor Position

-$600-$800 USD per month, depending on experience

-Performance-based bonuses

-Paid training

-Long-term career opportunity



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please submit your application through: applynow.excalbook.com



Applications submitted through OnlineJobs messages will not be reviewed.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Cybersecurity Technical Trainer & Platform Developer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Hirosoft Consulting is seeking a senior technical leader to design, build, secure, maintain, and deliver our Enterprise Cybersecurity and AI Training Academy. This is a hands-on senior leadership role requiring equal expertise in Software Development, Enterprise Cybersecurity, and Technical Training. The successful candidate will serve as Hirosoft's primary technical resource, responsible for independently architecting, building, maintaining, and delivering the training platform, corporate and client websites, enterprise cybersecurity labs, and live instructor-led training with minimal supervision. Candidates must demonstrate proven, expert-level practical ability in all three disciplines. The ideal candidate is a self-motivated technical leader who can independently own the complete lifecycle of platform development, enterprise cybersecurity implementation, website development, and technical training with little or no supervision.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architect, build, deploy, secure, maintain, and continuously improve the Enterprise Cybersecurity & AI Learning Platform Build and maintain the Hirosoft corporate website and client websites

Develop enterprise cybersecurity labs using free and open-source technologies

Deliver live online cybersecurity training and mentor students

Create technical documentation, installation guides, lab manuals, and training materials Continuously improve the platform, labs, and student learning experience

Design secure, scalable, and cost-effective technical solutions



REQUIRED SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT SKILLS (MANDATORY)

Full-Stack Development: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, Python, REST APIs, Git/GitHub.

Database: SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL.

LMS & Web Development: Moodle, Canvas, Open edX, LearnDash or WordPress LMS, responsive web design, authentication, API integration, payment integration, SEO.

DevOps & Deployment: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, Nginx, Apache, Linux Administration, SSL, Cloudflare, DNS, Domain Management.

Front-End Frameworks & CMS: WordPress, Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS.

Architecture & Design: Enterprise Solution Architecture, Secure Application Design, System Integration.



REQUIRED ENTERPRISE CYBERSECURITY SKILLS (MANDATORY)

Microsoft Enterprise Security: Entra ID, Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Sentinel, Intune, Purview.

Windows & Linux Administration: Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PowerShell, Ubuntu, Kali Linux, Bash. Networking & Cloud: TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Routing, Switching, Firewalls, Azure, AWS.

Enterprise Security: SOC Operations, I
 Response, Threat Hunting, Vulnerability Management, Identity & Access Management, Zero Trust, Governance, Risk Assessment, Compliance, Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery.

Security Tools: Wireshark, Nmap, Nessus Essentials, OpenVAS, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, OWASP Juice Shop, DVWA, Wazuh, Splunk, Sysmon, VirtualBox, Docker.



Candidates must have professional teaching experience and be able to:

Deliver engaging live technical training

Explain complex cybersecurity concepts clearly

Conduct enterprise hands-on labs

Mentor students and answer advanced technical questions

Troubleshoot technical issues during live classes

Develop PowerPoint presentations, lab guides, student manuals, instructor guides, technical documentation, and training videos Assess student performance and prepare learners for enterprise careers

Excellent written and spoken English is required.



AI PRODUCTIVITY SKILLS

Must effectively use ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, and Windsurf to accelerate software development, documentation, automation, website development, and training content creation.



OUR TECHNICAL APPROACH

We build enterprise-quality solutions while keeping costs low. The successful candidate should:

Prefer free and open-source technologies whenever practical Build secure, scalable, and maintainable systems

Minimize recurring licensing costs

Support a BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) learning model Design platforms that can grow without major redesign



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Proven expert-level software development skills with a strong portfolio Proven enterprise cybersecurity experience in real-world environments Proven instructor-led technical training experience

Experience building LMS platforms and professional websites

Ability to independently deliver enterprise-quality solutions with minimal supervision

Comfortable working in a startup environment, taking ownership of technical decisions and project delivery



HIRING PROCESS

Shortlisted candidates will complete the following assessments:

1. Technical Interview

2. Live Coding Assessment

3. Portfolio Review: Websites, LMS Platforms, GitHub Repositories, and Enterprise Projects

4. Enterprise Cybersecurity Interview

5. 30-Minute Live Technical Teaching Demonstration

6. Practical Cybersecurity Lab Demonstration



HOW TO APPLY

Please send an

Include the following in your
:

• A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile

title: Business Builder Wanted – Pitch Me a Subscription Business Idea
description:
I'm looking for someone who loves business, entrepreneurship, and building companies from scratch.



This is a paid job



Please do not apply if your idea is to start a VA agency.



I'm looking for a long-term partner who can help create a subscription-based business with recurring monthly revenue.

If you already own or have built a subscription business, I'd love to hear about it. If you don't, that's okay—let's come up with one together. This is a rare opportunity!



In your application, please answer:

What subscription business would you build if you had to start today?

Who is the ideal customer?

Why would people continue paying every month?

How much can this business bring in?

How would we get our first customers?

How would we market the business?

How would the business make money?

What do you think the startup costs would be?

What are the biggest risks?

Have you built or worked on any businesses before? If yes, tell me about them.

Why do you think your idea could become a $1 million+ business?

I'm not looking for another copy of an existing business unless you can explain why we'd have a competitive advantage.

I'm looking for someone who thinks creatively, does research, validates ideas, and is excited to build something meaningful from the ground up.

If you're passionate about entrepreneurship, I'd love to hear your ideas.
